title: 后端架构
scope: API contracts, state ownership, consistency, concurrency and safe data migrations.
routingDescription: API contracts, state ownership, consistency, concurrency and safe data migrations.
useWhen: Concurrent writes or retries can corrupt business state

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use debugging when the immediate need is to explain a concrete failing run.
Use reliability for incidents, SLOs and operational recovery.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When more than one component changes the same business object
diagnosticChecklist.check: Identify the authoritative state owner, invariants and transaction boundary.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Prefer a single explicit owner and explain consistency across boundaries.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When an external effect can time out or be retried
diagnosticChecklist.check: Separate admission, effect execution and result acknowledgement; inspect idempotency and reconciliation.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Treat an ambiguous effect as unknown until checked; propose a safe retry boundary.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When requests race or workers claim shared work
diagnosticChecklist.check: Check uniqueness, compare-and-set or leases and the consequences of losing ownership.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Name a concrete mechanism that prevents duplicate effects rather than assuming serial execution.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When evolving persisted data or API contracts
diagnosticChecklist.check: Check old readers/writers, backfill validation and rollout/rollback compatibility.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Recommend a staged migration with reconciliation and a defined rollback boundary.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Ask what the supplied scale, failure isolation and team constraints actually require.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Justify added services from evidence and state the simpler viable design.

evidenceRequirements: Current API/state schema and observed invariant violation
Concurrent and retry traces or an explicit statement that they are unavailable
Versions of readers/writers and representative historical records for migration decisions
qualityChecks: Give failure semantics for timeouts and partial work
Explain migration compatibility and unknown effects
Tie architectural complexity to a concrete requirement
riskRules: Irreversible writes and migrations require separately authorized execution and a recovery plan

preferredSources: Version-matched database and API provider specifications
Published consistency, idempotency and migration guarantees for the actual stack
refreshTriggers: Changing API contracts or database versions
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: Two workers charge once but one times out; the client retries.
examples.expected: Distinguish unknown effect from failed effect and require idempotency plus reconciliation.
examples.reject: Retry the charge automatically because no success reply arrived.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
